items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Emile Bones. I worked down there quite a while. At the Harmony Inn.

ctx.x: Walter. Walter. Walter Decoe. Oh, is he dead? I didn't know for sure if he's dead. Yeah, he's dead. I knew he wasn't playing anymore. They told me he was dead. That's what I heard. Yeah, I've never heard for sure if he died. Lawrence Torkum. Yeah. I knew him.
Emile Bones. I worked down there quite a while. At the Harmony Inn.
